newsitem.title: USA: Bentley in talks to sell French unit.
newsitem.headline: Bentley in talks to sell French unit.

text.p: Bentley Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday it was engaged in serious talks with a unit of "a large European conglomerate" to sell its French subsidiary, Chimos/LBF S.A.

The company said it expected to receive proceeds of about $3.9 million through sale proceeds and a capital reduction before the closing. The transaction was expected to be finalized early in the second quarter, Bentley said.
Chimos distributed chemical and pharmaceutical products.

The company said it expected to use proceeds from the deal to further its objectives of pursuing strategic alliances with multinational pharmaceutical companies and focusing on higher profit margin products.

Bentley said Chimos's sales began to decline in the second quarter of 1996 due to the expiration of a distribution agreement for the product Ceredase, a drug to Gauchers disease. Since then, Chimos revenues have averaged about $5.5 million per year, the company said.
